tlut_encoding: `tlut` is the normalised 0/2/3 mode. The hasher is called with it shifted left by G_MDSFT_TEXTLUT (14), because rt64's OtherMode::textLUT() returns `H & (3 << 14)` and never normalises the field. Feeding the unshifted value to TMEMHasher::hash reproduces every non-CI row and none of the CI rows with tlut > 0.
